title: Returned-Payment Fee Relief for Comfort Club Members (Home Comfort Financing)
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — financing benefit: returned-payment fees.**

The returned-payment member relief on Home Comfort Financing is 20 percent when the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active and has run at least 5 consecutive terms, 10 percent when that agreement is active and has run fewer than 5 consecutive terms, and zero when the borrower holds no active Comfort Club agreement.

The relief is one of the returned-payment reliefs: the returned-payment reliefs are added together into the returned-payment relief percentage, and the scheduled returned-payment fee is reduced once by that total, never one relief after another.

## Benefit by membership standing

| Agreement active? | Consecutive terms | Returned-payment member relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 5 or more | 20 percent |
| yes | fewer than 5 | 10 percent |
| no, or no agreement held | — | zero |

## Basis Q&A

**Which record decides it?** The borrower's Comfort Club agreement: whether its status is active, and how many consecutive terms it has run.

**A member in an active 5th consecutive term?** 20 percent.

**A scheduled fee of $20.00 with a returned-payment relief total of 20 percent (hypothetical)?** $20.00 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100: $16.00.
